description: Recommend surf gear sizes (wetsuit, board, leash, and boots if a shoe size is given) from a person's weight, height and surf level. Pure EU/Portugal sizing calculation — read-only, books or charges nothing. Useful before picking a lesson so the right gear is ready. Great for 'what wetsuit size do I need' or 'que prancha para 80 kg e 1,80 m'.

height.description: Height in centimetres, e.g. 180. Optional — improves the wetsuit fit.

shoeSizeEu.description: EU shoe size, e.g. 42. Optional — only needed for boots sizing.

name: size_equipment
title: Gear sizes
